description: Subscribe the user to a search: new matching leads arrive in their Telegram (or webhook) at most every 15 minutes. Needs the user's personal token (Authorization: Bearer mcp_…, made in their openradar profile). Ask the user before subscribing. Safety-ladder: the first call returns status "held" with a confirmation_token; the subscription is created only on a repeat call with identical arguments plus confirm:true and that token.

confirm.description: Set true (with confirmation_token) to execute a previously held subscription after the user approves

confirmation_token.description: The token returned by the held first call

market.description: ru = Russian-language posts, intl = the rest

min_budget_rub.description: Minimum budget or monthly pay in roubles

name: save_search
